quote: Woodin's Ω-conjecture was introduced in 1999 as part of his foundational work on Ω-logic in set theory, formally presented in his monograph "The Axiom of Determinacy, Forcing Axioms, and the Nonstationary Ideal" published by de Gruyter in 1999.
